DetailsDocument.Name: Core Identity Exposure - Monthly Access
DetailsDocument.Description: Monthly minimum commitment for Core Identity Exposure API access: breach exposure, SIM swap detection, infostealer log checks, domain lookalike detection, OAuth token exposure watchlist, and crypto threat intelligence.

DetailsDocument.Name: Breach Exposure Check
DetailsDocument.Description: Checks an email address against an aggregated breach corpus and dark web credential databases.

DetailsDocument.Name: SIM Swap Detection
DetailsDocument.Description: Detects recent SIM swap activity on a phone number, a common account takeover precursor.

DetailsDocument.Name: Infostealer Log Check
DetailsDocument.Description: Checks whether credentials for an identity appear in infostealer malware logs.

DetailsDocument.Name: Domain Lookalike Detection
DetailsDocument.Description: Finds typosquatted and lookalike domains registered against your brand.

DetailsDocument.Name: OAuth Token Exposure Watchlist
DetailsDocument.Description: Surfaces exposed OAuth and API tokens across leaked credential sources.

DetailsDocument.Name: Crypto Intelligence Check
DetailsDocument.Description: Checks wallets and domains against RelayShield's crypto threat intelligence corpus.
